coverage_notes: This exhaustive source survey spans natural language to structured-data interfaces across six major research angles: (1) NL2SQL/NL2VIS translation systems and benchmarks, covering recent LLM-era advances via comprehensive surveys and state-of-the-art papers; (2) ambiguity resolution and interactive disambiguation, capturing both automatic detection (AMBROSIA) and user-guided refinement (AmbiSQL, InteracSPARQL, DataTone); (3) semantic parsing foundations, covering compositionality, logical forms, and the formalism underlying mapping from natural language to structured queries; (4) visual analytics and data visualization interfaces, including multimodal interaction combining NL with direct manipulation; (5) user studies and error analysis, documenting common user misunderstandings and model failures in query composition and result interpretation; (6) foundational HCI literature on information visualization, mental models, cognitive load, and information foraging that grounds interface design principles. Coverage includes seminal single-author works (Tufte, Munzner, Norman, Shneiderman, Pirolli/Card) as the T2 anchor layer, recent systematic reviews and peer-reviewed surveys (T0-T1) from arXiv, TKDE, IEEE TVCG, ACM venues (SIGIR, IUI, TIIS), and high-quality recent system papers and benchmarks (2024-2025) covering test-time compute, schema linking, multi-hop reasoning, conversational interfaces, and error correction. Gaps acknowledged: limited coverage of non-English languages (1 reference), minimal discussion of cost/latency tradeoffs for real-time interfaces, and sparse literature on accessibility of NL interfaces for visually/hearing impaired users (2 W3C/accessibility references found). No paywalled sources included where free alternatives exist; some proprietary tool documentation (Tableau, Power BI) omitted as reference-only.

sources.title: A Survey of Text-to-SQL in the Era of LLMs: Where are we, and where are we going?
sources.notes: Comprehensive survey published in IEEE TKDE July 2025. Examines four dimensions: models (ambiguity, schema mapping), data (synthesis, benchmarks), evaluation metrics, and error analysis. Direct match for NL2SQL core topic.

sources.title: NLI4DB: A Systematic Review of Natural Language Interfaces for Databases
sources.notes: Frontiers of Computer Science, 2025. Systematic review organizing NLIDBs by processing stages (preprocessing, understanding, translation), methods taxonomy (rule-based, ML, hybrid), benchmarks, and LLM applications. Foundational for history and taxonomy.

sources.title: Towards Natural Language Interfaces for Data Visualization: A Survey
sources.notes: IEEE TVCG. Categorizes field via seven-stage pipeline (query interpretation -> data transformation -> visual mapping -> view transformation -> human interaction -> dialogue management -> presentation). Core NL2VIS reference.

sources.title: A Survey on Semantic Parsing
sources.notes: Kamath & Das. Covers rule-based to neural approaches for converting NL to logical forms executable on knowledge bases. Foundational for semantic parsing theory underlying NL->structured-output mapping.

sources.title: A Survey on Semantic Parsing from the perspective of Compositionality
sources.notes: Focuses on compositionality principle—meaning from constituent parts. Critical for understanding how complex queries decompose into simpler semantic units.

sources.title: Natural Language to SQL: State of the Art and Open Problems
sources.notes: VLDB 2024 (vol 18). Position paper identifying key challenges and open problems in NL2SQL field. Practical grounding for current state.

sources.title: Rethinking data in NL2SQL: a survey of what we have and what we expect
sources.notes: Springer Nature, 2025. Data-centric perspective on NL2SQL pipeline, examining data collection, synthesis, and benchmark construction.

sources.title: AMBROSIA: A Benchmark for Parsing Ambiguous Questions into Database Queries
sources.notes: NeurIPS 2024. Benchmark dataset specifically for ambiguity in QA—addresses scope, attachment, and vagueness ambiguities. Critical for ambiguity resolution angle.

sources.title: AmbiSQL: Interactive Ambiguity Detection and Resolution for Text-to-SQL
sources.notes: Automatically detects ambiguities in user queries and guides users through clarification questions. Exemplar for interactive disambiguation pattern.

sources.title: Are We Asking the Right Questions? On Ambiguity in Natural Language Queries for Tabular Data Analysis
sources.notes: User-centered study of ambiguity in tabular QA, examining real-world ambiguity types and user expectations.

sources.title: PleaSQLarify: Visual Pragmatic Repair for Natural Language Database Querying
sources.notes: Visual pragmatic repair approach for ambiguous NL database queries. Direct example of pragmatics applied to NL interfaces.

sources.title: nvAgent: Automated Data Visualization from Natural Language via Collaborative Agent Workflow
sources.notes: February 2025. Multi-agent workflow (processor, composer, validator) for NL->visualization. Recent state-of-the-art system design.

sources.title: VisEval: A Benchmark for Data Visualization in the Era of Large Language Models
sources.notes: Benchmark for evaluating LLMs on NL->visualization task, addressing multi-level implementation complexity.

sources.title: Automated Data Visualization from Natural Language via Large Language Models: An Exploratory Study
sources.notes: ACM TMOD / arXiv. Empirical study of LLM potential for NL2VIS with in-context learning analysis.

sources.title: NL2Vis Transformed: From Linguistic Abstraction to Visual Specification in the Generative AI Era
sources.notes: Springer Nature, 2025. Reviews NL2VIS evolution from early rule-based to modern LLM approaches.

sources.title: InteracSPARQL: An Interactive System for SPARQL Query Refinement Using Natural Language Explanations
sources.notes: Interactive refinement for knowledge graph queries using NL explanations. Pattern for pragmatic repair in SPARQL context.

sources.title: DataTone: Managing Ambiguity in Natural Language Interfaces for Data Visualization
sources.notes: Seminal work on ambiguity widgets and mixed-initiative interaction for NL visualization. Introduced interactive clarification pattern widely adopted.

sources.title: Quda: Natural Language Queries for Visual Data Analytics
sources.notes: NL visual data analytics system. Demonstrates task abstraction and visual mapping from NL.

sources.title: SUQL: Conversational Search over Structured and Unstructured Data with Large Language Models
sources.notes: Hybrid query language combining SQL with free-text primitives. Relevant for pragmatic interface design bridging structured/unstructured.

sources.title: A Survey on Table Question Answering: Recent Advances
sources.notes: Comprehensive survey of table QA methods (semantic-parsing, generative, extractive, matching, retriever-reader). Foundational for tabular data interfaces.

sources.title: A Comprehensive Survey on Table Question Answering: Datasets, Methods and Future Directions
sources.notes: 2026 update tracing evolution from rule-based -> neural -> PLM -> LLM methods. Current state-of-art taxonomy.

sources.title: TableEval: A Real-World Benchmark for Complex, Multilingual, and Multi-Structured Table Question Answering
sources.notes: Complex, multilingual benchmark for table QA. Addresses real-world dataset complexities.

sources.title: A Survey of the State-of-the-Art in Conversational Question Answering Systems
sources.notes: Comprehensive conversational QA survey covering dialogue systems, context management, and multi-turn interaction patterns.

sources.title: Disambiguation in Conversational Question Answering in the Era of LLMs and Agents: A Survey
sources.notes: Focuses on disambiguation in conversational context with multi-turn interaction and agent approaches.

sources.title: Interactive Question Answering Systems: Literature Review
sources.notes: Literature review of interactive QA systems. Covers user interaction patterns and feedback mechanisms.

sources.title: Interactive Question Clarification in Dialogue via Reinforcement Learning
sources.notes: RL-based approach to learning when and how to ask clarifying questions. Foundational for interactive disambiguation.

sources.title: Interactive Query Clarification and Refinement via User Simulation
sources.notes: SIGIR 2022. User simulation approach to query clarification. Relevant for pragmatic interaction design.

sources.title: CIRCLE: Multi-Turn Query Clarifications with Reinforcement Learning
sources.notes: Multi-turn clarification framework using RL for managing conversational disambiguation.

sources.title: User errors in database query composition
sources.notes: International Journal of Human-Computer Studies, 1995. Classic HCI study documenting user errors in SQL composition due to working memory load and misconceptions.

sources.title: Insights into Natural Language Database Query Errors: from Attention Misalignment to User Handling Strategies
sources.notes: ACM TIIS. User study of 26 participants on NL2SQL error discovery/repair. Documents model failures and user mental models.

sources.title: An Empirical Study of Model Errors and User Error Discovery and Repair Strategies in Natural Language Database Queries
sources.notes: IUI 2024. Controlled study showing current error-handling mechanisms have limited impact on user efficiency.

sources.title: Natural Language Interfaces for Databases: What Do Users Think?
sources.notes: User study on user perceptions and mental models of NL database interfaces. Directly addresses pragmatics and user expectations.

sources.title: SQLucid: Grounding Natural Language Database Queries with Interactive Explanations
sources.notes: Interactive explanation system for validating generated SQL. Bridges user mental model to system interpretation.

sources.title: Interactive Text-to-SQL Generation via Editable Step-by-Step Explanations
sources.notes: Step-by-step explanation and editing for NL2SQL. Supports user control and error recovery.

sources.title: QueryGenie: Making LLM-Based Database Querying Transparent and Controllable
sources.notes: Transparency and controllability in LLM query generation. Addresses user trust and understanding.

sources.title: Principles of Query Visualization
sources.notes: Visual representation principles for making queries understandable. Foundational for query explanation design.

sources.title: Enhancing Few-shot Text-to-SQL Capabilities of Large Language Models: A Study on Prompt Design Strategies
sources.notes: Systematic study of prompt design impact on NL2SQL performance. Relevant for pragmatic interaction patterns.

sources.title: A Survey on Employing Large Language Models for Text-to-SQL
sources.notes: Comprehensive survey of LLM approaches to NL2SQL, covering models, prompting, and retrieval strategies.

sources.title: Odin: A NL2SQL Recommender to Handle Schema Ambiguity
sources.notes: Addresses schema linking ambiguity in NL2SQL. Critical for structured data mapping challenges.

sources.title: OraPlan–SQL: A Planning-Centric Framework for Complex Bilingual NL2SQL Reasoning
sources.notes: Planning-centric approach with test-time compute for complex queries. Exemplifies reasoning-first strategy.

sources.title: StepChain GraphRAG: Reasoning Over Knowledge Graphs for Multi-Hop Question Answering
sources.notes: Multi-hop reasoning with BFS and question decomposition. Relevant for complex query understanding.

sources.title: Dynamic Semantic Graph Construction and Reasoning for Explainable Multi-hop Science Question Answering
sources.notes: Graph-based reasoning for multi-hop QA with explainability. Relevant for query decomposition and transparency.

sources.title: DeSQL: Interactive Debugging of SQL in Data-Intensive Scalable Computing
sources.notes: FSE 2024. Interactive debugging approach for SQL queries. Relevant for error recovery and user control.

sources.title: Qr-Hint: Actionable Hints Towards Correcting Wrong SQL Queries
sources.notes: Automated hints for SQL error correction. Supports user understanding and error recovery.

sources.title: LLM-based SPARQL Query Generation from Natural Language over Federated Knowledge Graphs
sources.notes: SPARQL generation from NL over knowledge graphs. Extension of NL->structured-output to semantic web context.

sources.title: Semantic Parsing for Question Answering over Knowledge Graphs
sources.notes: Comprehensive treatment of semantic parsing for KGQA. Foundational for formal semantics in structured queries.

sources.title: NL4DV: Toolkit for Natural Language Driven Data Visualization
sources.notes: Practical toolkit for translating NL to visualization grammar. Referenced as extension of DataTone ambiguity management.

sources.title: Characterizing Multimodal Interaction in Visualization Authoring Tools
sources.notes: Analysis of multimodal (NL + direct manipulation) interaction patterns in visualization tools.

sources.title: Adaptive Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Conversational Systems
sources.notes: Adaptive RAG for conversational interfaces. Relevant for pragmatic context-aware disambiguation.

sources.title: NL2Formula: Generating Spreadsheet Formulas from Natural Language Queries
sources.notes: NL to spreadsheet formula translation with large benchmark dataset. Parallel domain to SQL/SPARQL.

sources.title: Lexara: A User-Centered Toolkit for Evaluating Large Language Models for Conversational Visual Analytics
sources.notes: User-centered evaluation toolkit for LLM-driven visual analytics. Directly addresses user mental models and pragmatics.

sources.title: Natural Language Interfaces for Spatial and Temporal Databases: A Comprehensive Overview of Methods, Taxonomy, and Future Directions
sources.notes: Extends NL interfaces to spatial/temporal domains. Relevant for pragmatic challenges in domain-specific structures.

sources.title: Generating Analytic Specifications for Data Visualization from Natural Language Queries using Large Language Models
sources.notes: LLM-based generation of visualization specs from NL. Addresses task abstraction in NL2VIS.

sources.title: A Survey of Test-Time Compute: From Intuitive Inference to Deliberate Reasoning
sources.notes: Survey on test-time compute scaling. Relevant for understanding reasoning-centric approaches to complex query generation.

sources.title: Reasoning Language Models: A Blueprint
sources.notes: Framework for reasoning-augmented language models. Applicable to planning-centric NL->structured-output.

sources.title: Natural Language Interface Accessibility User Requirements
sources.notes: W3C standard identifying accessibility requirements for NL interfaces. Critical for inclusive design.

sources.title: Enabling Uniform Computer Interaction Experience for Blind Users through Large Language Models
sources.notes: LLM-augmented screen readers for accessible NL interfaces. Addresses accessibility angle of pragmatics.

sources.title: The Visual Display of Quantitative Information (2nd Edition)
sources.notes: Tufte (1983, revised 2001). Foundational textbook on data visualization principles and visual clarity. Underpins information visualization theory for NL->VIS mapping.

sources.title: Designing the User Interface: Strategies for Effective Human-Computer Interaction (6th ed.)
sources.notes: Shneiderman et al. (2016). HCI textbook covering mental models, interaction design, and information visualization. Foundational for NL interface usability.

sources.title: The Eyes Have It: A Task by DataType Taxonomy of Information Visualizations
sources.notes: Shneiderman (1996). Seminal information visualization mantra (overview -> zoom/filter -> details-on-demand). Influences taxonomy of NL->VIS tasks.

sources.title: Visualization Analysis and Design
sources.notes: Munzner (2014). Comprehensive visualization design framework (what-why-how). Core reference for task/data/idiom abstraction in NL2VIS.

sources.title: Information Foraging
sources.notes: Pirolli & Card (1999). Cost-benefit framework for information seeking behavior. Foundational for understanding user pragmatics in interface interaction.

sources.title: The Design of Everyday Things (mental models and conceptual design)
sources.notes: Norman (1988, revised). Foundational HCI work on mental models, affordances, and gulf of execution. Directly relevant to user expectations in NL interfaces.

sources.title: Natural Language Interfaces to Databases - An Introduction
sources.notes: Early NLIDB overview from 1995, covering history (LUNAR, LADDER, CHAT-80) and foundational approaches.

sources.title: Spider: Yale Semantic Parsing and Text-to-SQL Challenge
sources.notes: Major cross-domain NL2SQL benchmark with 10,181 examples across 200 databases. Standard evaluation dataset for field.

sources.title: Rethinking Agentic Workflows: Evaluating Inference-Based Test-Time Scaling Strategies in Text2SQL Tasks
sources.notes: Analysis of test-time scaling and agentic approaches for NL2SQL. Current state-of-art methodology.

sources.title: Conversational Lexicography: Querying Lexicographic Data on Knowledge Graphs with SPARQL through Natural Language
sources.notes: Conversational SPARQL query interface. Demonstrates pragmatics in domain-specific KG interfaces.

sources.title: A critical analysis of cognitive load measurement methods
sources.notes: Cognitive load theory and measurement. Relevant for understanding user comprehension limits in NL interface complexity.

sources.title: Linguistic ambiguity analysis in ChatGPT
sources.notes: Analysis of ambiguity handling in LLMs. Relevant for understanding failure modes in NL->structured-output.

sources.title: Composing or Not Composing? Towards Distributional Construction Grammars
sources.notes: Compositionality and construction grammars. Relevant for formal semantics of complex NL queries.

sources.title: Unveiling the Black Box of PLMs with Semantic Anchors: Towards Interpretable Neural Semantic Parsing
sources.notes: Interpretability in neural semantic parsing. Addresses transparency for user understanding.
